description: PB1 high (PC connected): PC mode entry (:w11=0,0, to both generators, PB2 pulse), PC traffic (:w11/:w14/:w24/:w25) on both links, PB1 low again: :w15=0,0, to both and back to HOME
note: The original accepts the PC-mode display commands only after the vendor unlock handshake (excluded from scope), which the scenario does not send, and shows the PC icon red until then; the reimplementation treats the link as always unlocked (application.md section 7, deliberate deviation). The PC icon is masked, and the pc_traffic screen is informational.
